basic_info.headline: Reliable bookkeeper freeing you to focus on your company’s growth.
basic_info.about:
A hands on Test Driven C# developer, trainer and coach.
You know how when you start with greenfield development, and trouble free changes changes are commonplace, but then after a while the code becomes hard and harder to change, and when it does change, bugs show.  I help to bring code back into that easy to change state that it was in at the beginning.
Did you ever have that team member who got stuff done, while happily sharing what they know with other members of the team?  That's me.
My mission-based from 4 years in the United States Marine Corps, combined with my experience, mindset and commitment provide the perfect ingredients to Get Things Done. 
I have taught TDD and DevOps in the United States, India, Malaysia and the Czech Republic.
If you are building your team and are in need of a hands on developer, who not only gets the business value of automated unit and integration tests but can explain it to others, reach out to me about joining your team.

experience.title: Owner
experience.description:
Entrepreneurs typically start by doing all the roles in their company, including the bookkeeping.
As time goes on, they realize that they are no longer the right person to do this work.

experience.title: Scrum Coach / Agile Engineering Coach
experience.description:
Facilitate continuous delivery & SaFe adoption at the enterprise level.
Coach teams & product owners to effective use of agile principles and practices.
Consult company Vice Presidents and senior executives in agile implementation best practices. 
Train and coach developer teams in use of TDD, ATDD and BDD using various tools.
Train product owner in proper backlog grooming techniques.
Business coach for owners of retail supply manufacturing company.
Conduct agile engineering training, facilitate leadership and self-organization classes.
Coach and trained clients in agile mindset and agile engineering practices.
Consult teams on pathways to transforming their practices and paired with developers.
Consult with principles on product management best practices.
Introduce new coding guidelines to better reflect company’s product oriented priorities.
Author of "Heart of a Developer: Testing in an Agile world" http://bit.ly/6Heart3

experience.title: The Dev in DevOps - Senior Systems Administrator
experience.description:
In 4 years as a Lead Systems Administrator improved up time by 2500% percent, from 99.5% uptime, to 99.998% up time. Conducted root cause analysis and eliminated a complex set of interaction issues that were causing ~200 annual data clean up incidents, saving 300 hours of labor per year. Trained 75 people in 5-Whys method of root cause analysis. Conducted 3 "Intro to DevOps" trainings to over 100 people.
Part of June 2023 KP Layoff Cost Reduction Layoff.
experience.position: The Dev in DevOps - Senior Systems Administrator

experience.title: The Dev in DevOps (Systems Administrator) CSIR
experience.description:
CSIR - Customer Service Information Repository - 
Operationalized information portal by reducing incident counts by 35% over 2 years.
Reduction was implemented by applying ITIL Incident and Problem solving methodologies.
Wrote automation code in C# to reduce deployment incidents by75%
experience.position: The Dev in DevOps (Systems Administrator) CSIR

experience.title: Scrum Coach / Agile Engineering Coach
experience.location: Canada, United States, Czech Republic, Malaysia
experience.description:
As a scrum coach I help organizations, and teams gain the OCM benefits of using the Scrum framework.  Primarily this is about clearing up misunderstanding about Scrum implementations, and aligning the business in order to shorten the distance between the customer & the development team, shrinking work batch size and speeding up the feedback cycle.

I teach Scrum Basics, and an Accelerated Agile Engineering Bootcamp.

volunteering-experiences.title: Volunteer
volunteering-experiences.subtitle: Lean Startup Circle - San Francisco
volunteering-experiences.caption: Aug 2014 - Aug 2016 · 2 yrs 1 mo
volunteering-experiences.description:
Learn from the Best
Everyone hits roadblocks.
When we do, it's important that we're able to get real help from people who have been there before. People who can share their success (and failure) stories so we can learn from them.
Real learning from real practitioners.

volunteering-experiences.title: IT Director
volunteering-experiences.subtitle: Experience Unlimited
volunteering-experiences.caption: Apr 2016 - Aug 2016 · 5 mos
volunteering-experiences.description: Member of the Board of Directors as a Co-Director of Information Technology.  As a voting member of the board, we help define policies and procedures, coordinate efforts with EDD of California and continue to explore ways to improve on our philosophy of offering a safe, supportive and strengthening environment for professional job seekers. New responsibilities include building a training program to bring new technical members on-board and up to speed on technologies that they may be unfamiliar with while ensuring the ongoing maintenance of the organizational assets.
